# KONOV Technologies

> KONOV Technologies is a company in Ghana that builds interactive tools to make technology fun to learn and create for young learners aged 6-16. MeAI is its first product: it helps kids and teenagers (ages 6-14) learn coding and AI by building projects in an interactive game world inspired by African life. KONOV also runs AI & coding classes in Accra: weekend classes, after-school programs, and summer school.

KONOV is a product-led company that teaches both AI and coding. Learners (ages 6-16) work with real data, train machine learning models, build chatbots and conversational AI, and create AI-powered projects. KONOV serves young learners, parents, schools, educators, tertiary students, NGOs, and organizations across Ghana and Africa.

## Key Facts

- Official brand name: KONOV Technologies (also referenced as KONOV).
- Product name: MeAI — KONOV's first product. MeAI helps kids and teenagers (ages 6-14) learn coding and AI by building projects in an interactive game world inspired by African life.
- Location: Accra, Ghana. Serves learners across Ghana and Africa.
- Contact: hello@konovtech.com
